svg.aria-label: Index-0 selector dial: a stamping press whose rotary field-name selector is locked at 0. Two parcels ride a conveyor — item 1 labelled data, item 2 labelled attachment — but the press stamps item 1's label, data, onto both; item 2's own attachment tag lies unread beside it. The lit orange lever is the fix: rename every item's binary key to one fixed name before the press.
